claim_ceiling: Repairs only the Active Path ZIP file handoff after a fresh scan. It does not change scan freshness, classification, owners, helpers, routes, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, persisted user data, or failure semantics, and it requires fresh iPhone proof after deployment.

ci_evidence.first_browser_run_note: Run 32910927794 already proved the real download event, ZIP signature, all three ZIP members, and fresh scan identity. Its sole failed assertion expected the pre-click ready status even though the successful automatic click had already changed the status to download requested. That proof-only assertion was corrected by exactly one line removed and one line added; run 32911185873 then passed all 12 checks.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: The prior Atlas browser certification proved fresh scan identity and classification truth but never exercised a browser download. The new matrix waits across the asynchronous scan boundary, requires a persistent real ZIP download link, directly clicks that link as a second user gesture, and verifies the resulting downloaded ZIP bytes and all three expected members.

observed_facts.fact: The fresh iPhone Atlas path completed but did not produce an attachable ZIP, leaving the user with a report too long to paste.
The pre-repair exporter performed its programmatic download click only after awaiting the fresh scan, and the existing permanent browser proof did not assert any download event or ZIP bytes.
The certified browser run produced a real ZIP download event after the asynchronous scan boundary, with a valid ZIP local-file signature and all three expected member names.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: A persistent direct download control prepared after the asynchronous scan restores a browser-trusted second user gesture without weakening the fresh-scan identity contract.
The prepared Blob URL must remain valid until direct user interaction or replacement; immediate post-click revocation would recreate the iPhone handoff failure.
